narrator.instruct: Fast, gripping, high-energy history storyteller. Excited and urgent, punchy emphasis on the surprising facts, brisk pace, no long pauses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's eighteen ninety-seven, and three men are flying a balloon to the North Pole.

voice.instruct: Dramatic, excited opening hook, urgent and amazed, hitting 'North Pole' hard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No engine. Just silk, hydrogen and wind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Right after takeoff, their steering ropes fall off.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then fog freezes on the balloon, and it sinks onto the ice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: After sixty-five hours, they're stranded, far short of the pole.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For three months, they drag heavy sleds across the broken ice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then they vanish. No bodies, no answers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thirty-three years later, Norwegian seal hunters land on White Island.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Under the snow, they find a boat, the men, and their diaries.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And their film still works. Ninety-three photos come back from the ice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last pictures of three men who never came home.
